title: Photography
slide_intent: Teach editors to select photographs by what a viewer can discover in them. Framing, perspective and depth can make a museum experience feel specific.
strategic_value: Images of visitors, objects and making can convey the range of Sheffield Museums’ activities across audiences.
demonstration: Two text columns describe image choices and contrasting qualities. The adjacent montage includes people looking, taking part and making things in varied light and scale.
practical_value: Compare the story in the copy with the photo’s focal action. Try a tighter crop or a different point of view when the connection is weak.

content_islands.name: Selection guidance
content_islands.spec: Use the first narrow column for image sourcing, framing and the relationship between picture and copy.

content_islands.name: Image qualities
content_islands.spec: Stack the desired and discouraged qualities in the second column. Keep their list headings distinct.

content_islands.name: Photograph montage
content_islands.spec: Arrange differently sized images at right. Pair visitors seen from behind with closer action, faces and environmental details.
